players.product: UPS systems (incl. YMK modular high-power UPS), integrated power modules, precision air conditioning, lead-acid / lithium batteries and micro-modular / containerized prefabricated data-center solutions; megawatt-class UPS, 800V HVDC and SST in development

quarterly_data.signal: VP and board secretary Fan Tao: high-power UPS, integrated power modules, thermal management and battery products are in stable supply at home and abroad; megawatt-class UPS, 800V HVDC, Panama power supply and SST solid-state transformers are in R&D and test certification, still at the validation / introduction stage with no volume orders or revenue contribution yet

VP and board secretary Fan Tao: overseas revenue is now more than half of the data-center business, mainly through an ODM model with several leading international power companies under long-term stable cooperation; focus on Europe and Southeast Asia while developing North America and Australia, with the Vietnam production base securing overseas order delivery

Kstar.why: Data-center power infrastructure maker (UPS, integrated power modules, precision cooling, micro-modules); data-center products were 58.89% of H1 2026 revenue and it delivers UPS and power modules to internet / IDC customers, so AI data-center build-outs drive its sales.
Kstar.evidence: Kstar half-year report: 2026 Semi-Annual Report (08-28-2026): in the IDC field the company delivers data-center UPS and power-module equipment to ByteDance, Alibaba, JD.com, GDS, VNET and others; smart power and data-center products revenue RMB 1,526,123,515.50, up 17.52%.
